objective: Recover the post-Alpha-140 map regression without weakening the rewarded-ad gate, deploy a correctly configured Alpha build, and obtain runtime evidence for both map rendering and rewarded-ad completion.
interpreted_requirements: Release builds must not upload with empty Naver, Google Maps, or TMap Dart defines.
Map startup and fallback must provide privacy-safe diagnostics without API key values.
Existing rewarded-ad logic must remain reward-only; no free-pass or policy bypass may be introduced.
Deploy the corrected Android App Bundle to Play Alpha and retain evidence.
Do not claim completion until an ADB-accessible physical device visibly renders a map and completes rewarded-ad load, show, reward, and AI conversation entry.

forbidden_files: existing rewarded-ad policy and Remote Config values
calendar, color, onboarding, and unrelated user-owned dirty files

root_cause.finding: The Alpha 140 AAB was built by a raw Flutter command that did not inject env/local.json Dart defines. The Android manifest and runtime environment consequently had no configured map provider keys although the build itself succeeded.
root_cause.remediation: The release builder now requires valid, non-placeholder map defines before version bump/build and delegates AAB creation through scripts/flutter-local.ps1, which injects env/local.json.

plan.item: Trace map configuration and release-build input path; verify rewarded-ad policy is unaffected.
Fail closed before release build when required map defines are missing or placeholders, and add safe map diagnostics/fallback visibility.
Add a narrow build-contract regression test.
Build and upload Alpha 141 with injected defines and inspect the generated release manifests without revealing key values.
Obtain visible physical-device map and rewarded-ad proof.

roles.assignment: Trace the map regression through Dart defines, Android manifest placeholders, startup initialization, location picker fallback, and existing rewarded-ad boundary.
roles.result: Confirmed the deployment regression: the prior raw appbundle command omitted env/local.json while the supported local Flutter launcher injects it. Confirmed the map depends on Naver/Google runtime defines and the rewarded-ad gate is a separate reward-only path.

roles.assignment: Define a scoped recovery plan that preserves unrelated work and requires code, artifact, upload, and device-runtime evidence.
roles.result: Classified release preflight/map startup behavior as Complex and contract coverage as Simple. Required no key-value logging, no ad policy changes, Alpha deployment evidence, and fail-closed device acceptance.

roles.assignment: Implement release define preflight and safe map initialization/location-screen diagnostics without touching unrelated work.
roles.result: Added required-key and placeholder preflight for GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY, TMAP_API_KEY, and NAVER_MAP_CLIENT_ID; retained flutter-local build delegation; added boolean-only provider/start/success/failure/fallback diagnostics. No key values, schedules, or ad bypasses are logged.

roles.assignment: Add focused coverage proving the internal AAB builder retains map preflight and invokes flutter-local rather than raw Flutter.
roles.result: Added the narrow build contract test.

roles.assignment: Run scoped static/contract verification, release build validation, artifact-manifest inspection, upload verification, and physical-device check when available.
roles.result: Contract test and release deployment evidence passed. The physical Android acceptance step cannot run because no ADB-accessible device is available.

roles.assignment: Independently review the final diff for map credential leakage, fallback correctness, rewarded-ad bypasses, and unrelated changes.
roles.result: PASS at code level. No BLOCKER or HIGH finding. The release preflight, flutter-local delegation, safe map diagnostics, fallback behavior, and reward-only gate are consistent. Reviewer requires physical-device proof before final completion.

roles.assignment: Reconcile final diff, role evidence, deployment, artifact inspection, and remaining runtime gates without modifying unrelated work.
roles.result: Code, contract test, AAB artifact, Alpha 141 upload, and manifest key-presence evidence are integrated. The task remains BLOCKED_DEVICE_RUNTIME because neither visible map rendering nor rewarded-ad load/show/reward/conversation entry can be proven without an ADB-accessible device.
